newsitem.title: USA: RenaissanceRe sets tender offer result.
newsitem.headline: RenaissanceRe sets tender offer result.

text.p: Bermuda-based RenaissanceRe Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that 1,941,575 of its common shares were tendered in a stock purchase plan that expired January 22, 1997.
RenaissanceRe has accepted 813,190 common shares for purchase and cancellation, the company said.
All of the 5,691 common shares tendered by odd-lot holders were accepted for purchase and cancellation, RenaissanceRe said.
The number of shares purchased from each tendering shareholder, other than odd-lot holders, were subject to a proration factor of which the final calculation is 41.71216 percent, RenaissanceRe said.
After the purchase, the company said it will have about 22.7 million shares outstanding.
